insights: 创新点：IrCu合金促进光催化CO2到甲烷
方法亮点：Ir/TiO2上的H2O吸附研究
关键发现：抑制*H转移生成H2
insights_en: Novelty: IrCu alloys promote photocatalytic CO2 to methane
Method highlight: Study of H2O adsorption on Ir/TiO2
Key finding: Inhibition of *H transfer leading to H2 by-product
abstract: Photocatalytic reduction of CO<sub>2</sub> to natural gas using water vapor is a promising strategy for carbon recycling and renewable energy storage. However, the selectivity of current catalysts still remains a big challenge. Herein, we construct IrCu alloys on TiO<sub>2</sub> nanosheets to promote photocatalytic CO<sub>2</sub> to methane with 98.6% selectivity and 7.9% quantum efficiency at 365 nm under non-sacrificial ambient conditions. The performance is competitive with most other reported metal-based photocatalysts. Experimental and theoretical calculations demonstrate that the intensive H<sub>2</sub>O adsorption on Ir/TiO<sub>2</sub> hinders *H transfer, inevitably generating the H<sub>2</sub> by-product. Conversely, hydrophobic Cu effectively optimizes the interfacial hydrogen-bond network on IrCu/TiO<sub>2</sub>, predominantly in H-down configurations for H<sub>2</sub>O adsorption on the asymmetric charge-polarized Cu<sup>δ+</sup>-Ir<sup>δ-</sup> structure, which facilitates the kinetic migration of dissociated *H to *CO-Cu sites, resulting in the reduced energy barrier for the key *CHO intermediate. This finding enables high CH<sub>4</sub> selectivity on IrCu/TiO<sub>2</sub>, deepening our understanding of gas-solid interfacial water vapor in the enhanced natural gas synthesis.

title: Mechanism of lipid-dependent cold sensitivity in a model ion channel
summary_zh: 研究模型细菌通道SthK的温度感应机制。SthK在低温下活性更高，其冷敏感性强烈依赖于膜脂。
summary_en: The molecular details of temperature sensing in the model bacterial channel SthK are investigated. SthK is cold sensitive, displaying higher activity below 30 °C, and its cold sensitivity depends strongly on membrane lipids.
insights: 创新点：研究SthK的温度感应机制
方法亮点：结合冷冻电镜、突变和功能实验
关键发现：SthK的冷敏感性依赖于膜脂
insights_en: Novelty: Study of the temperature sensing mechanism in SthK
Method highlight: Combination of cryo-EM, mutagenesis, and functional assays
Key finding: SthK cold sensitivity depends on membrane lipids
abstract: Temperature sensing enables organisms to detect and respond to environmental changes. While temperature-responsive ion channels are key to this process, the physico-chemical mechanisms by which they sense temperature remain poorly understood. Here, we investigate the molecular details of temperature sensing in the model bacterial channel, SthK from Spirochaeta thermophila. We show that SthK is cold sensitive, displaying higher activity below 30 °C. Remarkably, SthK cold sensitivity depends strongly on membrane lipids, being sensitive in amine-containing lipids but insensitive in anionic lipids. Combining cryo-EM structural analysis, mutagenesis, and functional assays, we identify an intersubunit salt bridge that acts as temperature sensor. This salt bridge forms only in closed states, and determines channel opening by controlling closed-state stability. Lower temperatures weaken salt-bridge interactions, favoring channel opening, and lipid headgroups tune temperature sensitivity by modulating salt-bridge strength. These findings highlight how thermosensitivity can emerge from cooperative interactions between protein and the surrounding membrane.

title: Extreme Illuminated Vision Processing with a Graded Alloyed Perovskite In-sensor Computing Network
summary_zh: 报告了一种分级Pb-Sn合金钙钛矿异质结光电二极管，实现可见光到红外光的检测。开发晶圆级成像处理器，实现生物医学检测和时空轨迹编码。
summary_en: A graded Pb-Sn alloyed perovskite heterojunction photodiode enabling detection from visible to infrared light is reported. A wafer-scale imaging processor is developed for biomedical detection and spatiotemporal trajectory encoding.
insights: 创新点：分级Pb-Sn合金钙钛矿光电二极管
方法亮点：晶圆级成像处理器开发
关键发现：生物医学检测和时空轨迹编码
insights_en: Novelty: Graded Pb-Sn alloyed perovskite photodiode
Method highlight: Development of wafer-scale imaging processor
Key finding: Biomedical detection and spatiotemporal trajectory encoding
abstract: In-sensor computing is proposed to reduce energy expenditure and processing latency by unifying sensing and computation within the hardware layer, yet the application under extreme illuminating scenario remains constrained by simultaneously obtaining broadband responsivity, large linear dynamic range and fast response. Here, we report a fully vapor-deposited graded Pb-Sn alloyed perovskite heterojunction photodiode with improved crystal quality. It enables the detection of light from visible to infrared light with a 230 dB linear dynamic range and 33 ns response time. We also develop a wafer-scale imaging processor by integrating the photodiode to a reconfigurable array. With this approach, we demonstrate biomedical detection and spatiotemporal trajectory encoding. The in-sensor processor realizes low-power high-resolution visible to infrared wavelength edge detection, adaptive background suppression under dim light and noise-immune high-speed dynamic imaging. Our results extend the options for in-sensor computing hardware, and thus pave a way toward practical artificial intelligent machine vision.

title: Gallium in liquid state shows nuclease-mimicking activity
summary_zh: 液态镓表现出类似核酸酶的活性，具有特定的切割位点。机制涉及核苷酸偏吸附和羟基自由基辅助的磷酸二酯水解。
summary_en: Gallium in the liquid state exhibits nuclease-like activity with preferred cleaving sites. The mechanism involves nucleotide-biased adsorption and hydroxyl radical-assisted phosphodiester hydrolysis.
insights: 创新点：液态镓表现出核酸酶活性
方法亮点：研究核苷酸偏吸附和羟基自由基作用
关键发现：形成无配体和辅因子的人工核酸酶
insights_en: Novelty: Liquid gallium shows nuclease-like activity
Method highlight: Study of nucleotide-biased adsorption and hydroxyl radical action
Key finding: Formation of an artificial nuclease without ligands and cofactors
abstract: Replicating biological systems using non-living materials, from the foundational molecular level to complex tissue structures, is central to abiotic mimicry. Enzymes play a vital role in these systems; however, replicating their enzymatic power with minimal components remains a key challenge. Here we show that gallium in the liquid state exhibits nuclease-like activity with preferred cleaving sites. The mechanism involves nucleotide-biased adsorption and hydroxyl radical-assisted phosphodiester hydrolysis. Compared with previously reported artificial metallonucleases, the liquid gallium uniquely integrates its oxide layer for substrate adsorption and its metallic core with electrons as a cleavage active center, forming a ligand- and cofactor-free artificial nuclease platform. Moreover, their activity is tunable through synthesis parameters and external stimuli, enabling programmable control with spatial or temporal precision. This work presents a minimalistic yet functional approach to enzyme mimicry, expanding the design space for abiotic enzymatic systems and offering potential opportunities in therapeutic applications, synthetic biology, and biomaterials.

title: Ultrahigh strength magnesium via solidification of nanocolloid
summary_zh: 通过固化和纳米胶体溶液中的纳米碳化铌制备超高强度镁。NbC在熔融镁中自发润湿，形成Mg@NbC纳米胶体。
summary_en: Ultrahigh-strength magnesium is produced by solidifying a colloidal solution containing nanoscale niobium carbide (NbC) particles suspended in liquid magnesium (Mg(l)). NbC spontaneously wets with molten Mg, forming Mg@NbC nanocolloid.
insights: 创新点：通过固化和纳米胶体制备超高强度镁
方法亮点：NbC在熔融镁中自发润湿
关键发现：Mg@NbC纳米胶体形成
insights_en: Novelty: Production of ultrahigh-strength magnesium by solidification of nanocolloid
Method highlight: Spontaneous wetting of NbC in molten Mg
Key finding: Formation of Mg@NbC nanocolloid
abstract: We report a simple, scalable route to produce ultrahigh-strength magnesium (Mg) via solidification of a colloidal solution containing nanoscale niobium carbide (NbC) particles suspended in liquid magnesium (Mg(l)). A single-atom-level investigation reveals that NbC exhibits spontaneous wetting with molten Mg, driven by the formation of an ordered layer of Mg atoms strongly bonded to the carbon atoms on the NbC {001} surface. This creates Mg-coated NbC (Mg@NbC) particles in liquid Mg and is referred to as Mg(l)-Mg@NbC nanocolloid. This unique and spontaneous wetting behaviour enables uniform nanoparticle dispersion in the molten Mg without external fields, and in the solidified Mg matrix without the need for thermomechanical processing. The resulting NbC dispersoids act as coherent, hard reinforcement phases, significantly strengthening the Mg matrix. As a result, the Mg-NbC material exhibits ultrahigh tensile strength and stiffness, surpassing those of all previously reported Mg alloy systems.

title: Regional priorities in implementing forestation and wind energy as climate solutions in facing their trade-offs
summary_zh: 研究森林植被与风力发电在气候解决方案中的权衡。模拟分析不同区域碳封存与风力发电潜力。发现热带地区碳封存潜力大但风力发电损失小。
summary_en: This study investigates the trade-offs between forestation and wind energy in climate solutions. Simulation analyzes carbon sequestration and wind energy potential across different regions. It finds that tropical regions have high carbon sequestration potential with minimal wind energy loss.
insights: 创新点：区域差异分析碳-能源权衡
方法亮点：耦合陆地-大气模拟
关键发现：热带地区碳封存潜力大
insights_en: Novelty: Regional analysis of carbon-energy trade-offs
Method highlight: Coupled land-atmosphere simulations
Key finding: High carbon sequestration potential in tropical regions
abstract: Both forestation and wind-energy upscaling are crucial climate solutions, but they may have conflicts as forestation can increase surface roughness and reduce wind speed. Here, based on coupled land-atmosphere simulations with contrasting forest areas, we report a notable trade-off between wind energy and carbon sequestration across a range of potential forestation areas. A maximum global forestation area of 1508 Mha is estimated to enable a biomass carbon sequestration of 90.7 GtC but also contribute to a 19.5% reduction in global onshore wind energy technical potential. The strength of such carbon-energy trade-offs, however, differs among different regions. Tropics could provide large forestation-induced carbon sequestration but have a small loss in wind energy potential. Large-scale forestation in Europe and US mainland may diminish not only wind energy potential but also energy generation of their current wind installations. Our results highlight the importance of maximizing the collective benefits of potentially competing climate solutions.

title: Unconventional magnon-mediated spin torque enabled by ferroelectric domain engineering in multiferroic BiFeO3
summary_zh: 利用铁电畴工程在多铁性BiFeO3中实现非传统磁子介导自旋扭矩。观察到传统自旋源材料激发非传统磁子偏振。产生独特自旋偏振。
summary_en: This study utilizes ferroelectric domain engineering in multiferroic BiFeO3 to enable unconventional magnon-mediated spin torque. Observes that conventional spin-source materials excite unconventional magnon polarization, producing unique spin polarization.
insights: 创新点：铁电畴工程实现磁子介导自旋扭矩
方法亮点：多铁性材料与自旋源材料结合
关键发现：非传统磁子偏振激发
insights_en: Novelty: Ferroelectric domain engineering for magnon-mediated spin torque
Method highlight: Integration of multiferroic materials with spin-source materials
Key finding: Excitation of unconventional magnon polarization
abstract: Spin current provides an energy-efficient approach for manipulating magnetization, when its spin polarization aligns with the magnetization direction. However, conventional spin-source materials possess high crystalline symmetry, restricting spin polarization to be orthogonal to both spin and charge current directions. Here, we overcome this limitation by utilizing the concept of magnon-mediated spin-orbit torque through integration of the insulating multiferroic BiFeO<sub>3</sub> with a conventional spin-source material. We observe that spin polarization generated by conventional spin-source material can excite unconventional magnon polarization due to the interplay between cycloidal antiferromagnetic order and the ferroelectric domain structure in BiFeO<sub>3</sub>. This produces an unconventional magnon torque that allows deterministic, field‑free switching of in‑plane magnetization collinear with the current direction, unattainable with conventional spin-source materials. Our results establish multiferroic-based heterostructure as a symmetry‑engineered magnon spin source, paving the way for low-power spintronic devices.

title: Structural motifs of gold cluster anions with 17 to 69 atoms
summary_zh: 通过优化DFT计算，精确识别17至69原子金簇阴离子的结构。许多结构高度对称，具有特殊化学性质。
summary_en: Optimized DFT calculations enable precise identification of structures of gold cluster anions with 17 to 69 atoms. Many structures are highly symmetric with unique chemical properties.
insights: 创新点：DFT计算精确识别金簇阴离子结构
方法亮点：结合模拟与实验数据
关键发现：高度对称结构
insights_en: Novelty: DFT calculations for precise identification of gold cluster anions
Method highlight: Combination of simulation and experimental data
Key finding: Highly symmetric structures
abstract: Gold has very special bonding properties, which is mainly due to strong relativistic effects influencing its electronic system. Gold clusters therefore, exhibit a large variety of structures not seen for other metallic systems. However, a reliable identification of these structures, which usually is based on a comparison of simulated and measured spectra, has been difficult as calculations often could not reproduce the measurements even if the correct structural motif was assumed. Here we show that optimized DFT calculations can yield a close to perfect agreement between measured and simulated photoelectron spectra, which in combination with extensive structural searches permitted us to identify geometries of cluster anions with 17 to 69 atoms. Many of these turn out to be highly symmetric, demonstrating that the special bonding properties of gold do not favor amorphous structures. These results provide a basis for a more precise treatment of gold nanostructures.

title: Interfacial Ru/RuOx heterostructures on carbon support regulate selectivity in lignin hydrodeoxygenation
summary_zh: 碳纳米纤维上的Ru/RuOx异质结构调控木质素加氢脱氧选择性。优化催化剂实现高饱和环烷烃选择性。
summary_en: Ru/RuOx heterostructures on carbon nanofibers regulate selectivity in lignin hydrodeoxygenation. Optimized catalyst achieves high selectivity towards saturated cycloalkanes.
insights: 创新点：碳纳米纤维上Ru/RuOx异质结构调控
方法亮点：热处理调节Ru氧化态
关键发现：高饱和环烷烃选择性
insights_en: Novelty: Ru/RuOx heterostructures on carbon nanofibers for selectivity regulation
Method highlight: Thermal treatment for tuning Ru oxidation state
Key finding: High selectivity towards saturated cycloalkanes
abstract: Constructing well-defined heterostructure interfaces in catalysts provides an approach to modulate scaling constraints and steer reaction pathways in biomass upgrading. Herein, we demonstrate that thermal restructuring of hydroxyl groups on carbon nanofibers (CNF) induces the formation of heterostructures of Ru/RuO<sub>x</sub>, which function as bifunctional active sites for the one-pot hydrodeoxygenation (HDO) of lignin to liquid hydrocarbons. The optimized 5 wt% Ru/CNF catalyst delivers promising performance, achieving a mass/carbon yield of 49.1%/67.7%, with high selectivity toward saturated cycloalkanes. X-ray absorption spectroscopy and near-ambient pressure X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy confirm that thermal treatment of CNF tunes the oxidation state of Ru. DFT calculations reveal that O-rich Ru/CNF forms interfacial heterostructures of Ru/RuO<sub>x</sub> polarized active sites, characterized by O<sup>δ</sup>⁻···Ru<sup>δ++</sup>···Ru<sup>δ+</sup> ensembles that heterolytically activate H<sub>2</sub> and strongly polarize C-O bonds in phenolic intermediates. The cooperative interplay between metallic Ru and partially oxidized RuO<sub>x</sub> interfacial sites lowers the energy barriers for hydrogenation and deoxygenation reactions, enabling a cooperative‌ reaction pathway. These insights elucidate the molecular basis of tunable selectivity in lignin HDO and demonstrate that a polarized, oxygen-decorated metal-support interface provides general design principles for engineering next-generation catalysts for sustainable fuel production.

title: Fe(III) complexes with prolonged luminescence lifetimes via excited-state equilibration promoted by reversible intercomponent electron transfer
summary_zh: 通过可逆组分间电子转移促进激发态平衡，实现Fe(III)复合物长寿命发光。室温下溶液中发光寿命可达6.5纳秒。
summary_en: Long-lived luminescence in Fe(III) complexes is achieved through excited-state equilibration promoted by reversible intercomponent electron transfer, with lifetimes up to 6.5 ns in solution at room temperature.
insights: 创新点：激发态平衡延长发光寿命
方法亮点：可逆电子转移促进激发态平衡
关键发现：室温下长寿命发光
insights_en: Novelty: Excited-state equilibration extends luminescence lifetime
Method highlight: Reversible electron transfer promotes excited-state equilibration
Key finding: Long-lived luminescence at room temperature
abstract: Achieving long-lived luminescence in complexes of earth-abundant metals remains challenging because excited states in first-row transition-metal systems typically deactivate rapidly under ambient conditions. Strategies capable of prolonging emission lifetimes in such compounds are therefore of considerable interest. Here we show that iron(III) complexes incorporating pyrene-functionalized ligands display luminescence in fluid solution at room temperature with lifetimes up to 6.5 ns. Spectroscopic analysis indicates that excited-state equilibration occurs through reversible intramolecular electron transfer from the pyrene unit to the iron centre, generating a charge-separated state. Although the ligand-to-metal charge-transfer state can also undergo reversible energy transfer to nearby pyrene triplet states, intramolecular electron transfer dominates, leading to the formation of a pyrene + -iron(II) charge-separated state that acts as a long-lived excited-state reservoir. Equilibration involving this state produces biphasic emission from the iron centre. These findings identify reversible intercomponent electron transfer as a strategy for achieving prolonged luminescence lifetimes in complexes of earth-abundant metals.

title: Exploring the feasible net-zero transition pathway in China considering energy system flexibility
summary_zh: 考虑能源系统灵活性，探索中国实现碳中和的可行路径。子年度模型优化供需侧灵活性。
summary_en: This study explores feasible net-zero transition pathways in China, considering energy system flexibility. A sub-annual model optimizes supply and demand-side flexibility.
insights: 创新点：考虑能源系统灵活性探索碳中和路径
方法亮点：子年度模型优化灵活性
关键发现：高可再生能源和高电气化系统
insights_en: Novelty: Exploring net-zero transition pathways considering energy system flexibility
Method highlight: Sub-annual model for flexibility optimization
Key finding: High variable renewable energy and high electrification energy system
abstract: Net-zero energy transition is projected to accelerate the replacement of fossil fuels with renewables, leaving system flexibility resources increasingly scarce. Here, we present a sub-annual energy-environment-economy model with endogenous hourly energy demand profiles and power balance dynamics including power dispatch, storage operations and demand-side response that co-optimizes supply- and demand-side flexibility, to map feasible transition pathways for China. The results show that compared with coarser timeslice representative of common modelling practice, sub-annual representation tightening flexibility needs with a high variable renewable energy and high electrification energy system. Results reveal steeper load ramps and frequent evening price strikes, identify increased activities in thermal power, nuclear power, hydrogen production, and energy storage. Accounting for temporal variability in supply and demand, the cost-optimal solution exhibits marginal abatement costs that are over 9% higher, but incorporating demand-side flexibility measures can mitigate cost growth and delineates least-regret portfolios for reliable, affordable decarbonization. Incentives for demand-side response such as load time-shifting and vehicle-to-grid can reduce investment in pumped hydro by 23% and yield more than a threefold cost-benefit ratio. The study highlights enhanced modelling of temporal dynamics within future energy model development and incentive-compatible market mechanism design for dispatchable resource development.

title: Electronic band and core-shell structure engineering enables ultrahigh energy storage in high-entropy ceramics
summary_zh: 通过电子能带和核壳结构工程实现高熵陶瓷的超高能量存储。高熵设计实现电荷载体传输限制和极化旋转促进。
summary_en: Electronic band and core-shell structure engineering enable ultrahigh energy storage in high-entropy ceramics. High-entropy design restricts charge carrier transport and promotes polarization rotation.
insights: 创新点：电子能带和核壳结构工程提高能量存储
方法亮点：高熵设计实现多效应
关键发现：电荷载体传输限制和极化旋转促进
insights_en: Novelty: Electronic band and core-shell structure engineering for high energy storage
Method highlight: High-entropy design for multi-effect
Key finding: Restriction of charge carrier transport and promotion of polarization rotation
abstract: Relaxor ferroelectric ceramics are promising energy-storage candidates for high-power electronic systems owing to their high energy density and fast charge-discharge speed. However, achieving ultrahigh energy density still poses challenges due to the inherently inverted coupling relationship between polarization (P) and breakdown electric field (E<sub>b</sub>). Here, we propose a high-entropy strategy to decouple polarization from breakdown electric field. The high-entropy design exerts a triple effect, which involves flattening electronic band to restrict the transport of charge carriers, driving the formation of core-shell heterostructure to suppress electrical breakdown, and stabilizing polymorphic polar phases to promote polarization rotation. The triple synergy effect led to an ultrahigh E<sub>b</sub> and a maximized polarization disparity (ΔP = P<sub>m</sub> - P<sub>r</sub>). As a result, the high-entropy ceramics exhibit an ultrahigh recoverable energy density (W<sub>rec</sub>) of 10.23 ± 0.99 J/cm<sup>3</sup> and a satisfactory efficiency (η) of 85.44% ± 3.34%, alongside good cycling reliability and temperature stability. This work provides an innovative design paradigm for achieving excellent energy storage performance of dielectric capacitors.

title: Intrinsic topological Weyl phase transition induced by a magnetostructural transformation in a kagome magnet
summary_zh: 通过kagome磁体的磁结构转变诱导本征拓扑魏尔相变。揭示结构、磁性和魏尔物理学的相互作用。
summary_en: An intrinsic topological Weyl phase transition is induced by a magnetostructural transformation in a kagome magnet, revealing the interplay between structure, magnetism, and Weyl physics.
insights: 创新点：磁结构转变诱导拓扑魏尔相变
方法亮点：高分辨率中子衍射和计算
关键发现：结构对称性变化
insights_en: Novelty: Magnetostructural transformation induces topological Weyl phase transition
Method highlight: High-resolution neutron diffraction and calculations
Key finding: Changes in lattice and magnetic symmetries
abstract: Topological phase transitions provide a unique window into the interplay between structure, magnetism, and Weyl physics in magnetic Weyl semimetals. However, realizing an intrinsic Weyl phase transition between two distinct Weyl states near room temperature remains challenging. Here, we demonstrate that a magnetostructural transition effectively induces such a transition in the kagome magnet Mn<sub>3</sub>Ga. High-resolution neutron diffraction, magnetization characterizations and first-principles calculations reveal that Mn<sub>3</sub>Ga undergoes a chiral antiferromagnetic transition below 485 K, followed by a magnetostructural transition to a monoclinic structure with highly canted antiferromagnetic order near room temperature. These cooperative changes in lattice and magnetic symmetries reorganize Weyl nodes, driving a transition from a primary type-II Weyl state to a distinct Weyl state, accompanied by dramatic variations in the anomalous Hall effect and appearance of topological Hall effect. Our findings open a new pathway for discovering novel topological Weyl states and advancing potential spintronic applications.

title: Water-based UV-ozone activation enables aggregation-free processing of MFI nanosheets for membrane fabrication
summary_zh: 本文研究利用水基UV-ozone处理MFI纳米片，避免干燥和聚集。方法上，通过水溶液中处理纳米片。实验表明，该方法确保了高产量溶剂分散的开放孔纳米片。
summary_en: This paper investigates the use of UV-ozone treatment in aqueous solution to activate MFI nanosheets without drying and aggregation. The method involves treating the nanosheets in an aqueous solution. Experiments show that this method ensures high yields of solvent-dispersed open-pore nanosheets.
insights: 创新点：水基UV-ozone处理避免了纳米片聚集
方法亮点：在水溶液中处理纳米片，保持开放孔结构
关键发现：该方法确保了高产量溶剂分散的开放孔纳米片
insights_en: Novelty: Water-based UV-ozone treatment avoids nanosheet aggregation
Method highlight: Treatment in an aqueous solution maintains open-pore structure
Key finding: The method ensures high yields of solvent-dispersed open-pore nanosheets
abstract: Zeolite nanosheets offer promising opportunities to fabricate ultrathin molecular sieving platforms for energy-efficient and cost-effective gas separation. However, activating these nanosheets requires a high-temperature calcination process that opens the pores, causing drying and subsequent irreversible aggregation. Once aggregated, most nanosheets cannot be well-aligned to form a continuous thin membrane, which is a persistent bottleneck for mixed matrix membrane fabrication. In this study, we present a facile ultraviolet (UV)-ozone treatment that activates zeolite nanosheets (MFI and SAPO-34) in aqueous solution. This treatment prevents the drying and aggregation of the nanosheets, thereby ensuring high yields of solvent dispersion for open-pore nanosheets. Furthermore, the UV-ozone treatment also introduces hydroxyl groups on the nanosheet surface that enhance both CO<sub>2</sub> adsorption and interfacial compatibility with the polymer matrix. The activated nanosheets are then used to fabricate micrometer-thick, highly b-oriented MFI mixed matrix membranes on polymer substrates via solution casting. These membranes demonstrate high CO<sub>2</sub>/N<sub>2</sub> selectivity of 40 ± 6, with permeance of 194 ± 50 GPU (at 25 °C, ambient pressure). This method is thus substantiated as an effective and scalable approach for activating zeolite nanosheets and can be a cost-efficient approach for the fabrication of thin, flexible zeolite-nanosheet-based gas separation membranes.

title: Equatorward upper-ocean heat transport from the Southern Ocean boosted interglacial warming
summary_zh: 本文研究MBT后海洋热传输对间冰期变暖的影响。方法上，通过重建西太平洋赤道西部深部和底层温跃层温度。实验表明，MBT后深温跃层温度逐渐下降，底层温跃层温度显著上升。
summary_en: This paper studies the impact of upper-ocean heat transport from the Southern Ocean on interglacial warming after the MBT. The method involves reconstructing deep and bottom thermocline temperatures from the western equatorial Pacific. Experiments show that the deep thermocline temperature has gradually declined after the MBT, while the bottom thermocline temperature shows a pronounced rising trend.
insights: 创新点：揭示MBT后海洋热传输对间冰期变暖的影响
方法亮点：重建西太平洋赤道西部深部和底层温跃层温度
关键发现：深温跃层温度下降，底层温跃层温度上升
insights_en: Novelty: Reveals the impact of upper-ocean heat transport on interglacial warming after the MBT
Method highlight: Reconstruction of deep and bottom thermocline temperatures from the western equatorial Pacific
Key finding: Deep thermocline temperature decline, bottom thermocline temperature rise
abstract: The Mid-Brunhes Transition (MBT) signifies a pivotal shift in glacial-interglacial cycles with intensified interglacial warming, yet its underlying mechanisms remain elusive. Targeting the most sensitive component of oceanic heat uptake, the southern-sourced sub-surface waters, the post-MBT ocean heat dynamics are investigated using reconstructed deep and bottom thermocline temperatures from the Western Equatorial Pacific. Our results show that, since the MBT, the deep thermocline temperature has been gradually declining in association with cooling within the (sub)tropical Pacific upper ocean circulation. In contrast, the bottom thermocline temperature shows a pronounced rising trend independent of the calibration-derived uncertainties in its absolute estimates. Such post-MBT bottom thermocline warming is consistent with an enhanced advection of southern-sourced subsurface waters, as indicated by strengthened Southern Ocean meridional thermal gradients and concurrent warming in the southern subtropics. It is thus suggested that enhanced equatorward transport of southern-sourced subsurface waters, as a cross-hemispheric heat-redistribution pathway, may have elevated the background thermal state of post-MBT interglacials, highlighting the potential role of tropical-Southern Ocean connection in shaping climate trajectories.

title: Inboard advance of arc magmatism regulates mountain building in the Andes
summary_zh: 本文研究安第斯山脉弧岩浆作用对造山运动的影响。方法上，整合碎屑和基岩地热和地球化学记录。实验表明，弧岩浆作用和前陆盆地发展在短时间内周期性增加。
summary_en: This paper studies the impact of arc magmatism on mountain building in the Andes. The method involves integrating detrital and bedrock geothermal and geochemical records. Experiments show that there are recurring phases of increased arc magmatism and foreland basin development over short timescales.
insights: 创新点：揭示弧岩浆作用对安第斯山脉造山运动的影响
方法亮点：整合碎屑和基岩地热和地球化学记录
关键发现：弧岩浆作用和前陆盆地发展周期性增加
insights_en: Novelty: Reveals the impact of arc magmatism on mountain building in the Andes
Method highlight: Integration of detrital and bedrock geothermal and geochemical records
Key finding: Recurring phases of increased arc magmatism and foreland basin development
abstract: Debate continues over the mechanisms that govern the tempo and style of arc magmatism and retroarc deformation along ocean-continent plate boundaries. Here we integrate detrital and bedrock geo/thermochronological and geochemical records of Cenozoic arc magmatism with results on the spatiotemporal evolution of retroarc shortening and flexural subsidence to explore the interactions and feedbacks among subduction, magmatism, and crustal deformation in the southern Central Andes. A synthesis of igneous compositions, magmatic activity, thrust belt shortening, and sediment accumulation reveals recurring phases of increased arc magmatism, retroarc underthrusting, and foreland basin development over short ( < 10 Myr) timescales. Episodic advance of deformation was focused within discrete Andean tectonic provinces (of contrasting pre-Andean inheritance) that were sequentially activated toward the foreland along newly formed middle/upper-crustal décollements. Inboard migration of arc magmatism consistently preceded deformation advance, suggesting that fluid-assisted weakening above the subducting slab facilitated enhanced shortening and orogenic growth toward the cratonic interior.

title: Broadband comb spectroscopy through spectral envelope shaping
summary_zh: 本文研究通过光谱包络形状实现宽带梳状光谱。方法上，利用单量子级联激光器构建非干涉测量装置。实验表明，该方法实现了对有机溶剂蒸气的目标和非目标分析。
summary_en: This paper studies broadband comb spectroscopy through spectral envelope shaping. The method involves building a non-interferometric setup using a single Quantum Wwalk Ccomb laser. Experiments show that this method enables targeted and non-targeted analysis of various organic solvent vapors.
insights: 创新点：通过光谱包络形状实现宽带梳状光谱
方法亮点：利用单量子级联激光器构建非干涉测量装置
关键发现：实现了对有机溶剂蒸气的目标和非目标分析
insights_en: Novelty: Achieves broadband comb spectroscopy through spectral envelope shaping
Method highlight: Builds a non-interferometric setup using a single Quantum Wwalk Ccomb laser
Key finding: Enables targeted and non-targeted analysis of organic solvent vapors
abstract: Optical frequency combs have facilitated fast and compact multi-component chemical analysis due to their broad spectral bandwidth. Although dual-comb spectrometers are an established implementation of this technology, their design requires a pair of matched combs with high mutual coherence, making the system considerably complex. In this study, we propose and implement a rapid, compact and broadband spectroscopy technique that operates without moving components, leveraging the stability, controllability and speed of a single Quantum Wwalk Ccomb laser. By using a comb based on a Quantum Cascade Laser, emitting within the molecular fingerprint region of the mid-infrared spectrum, we build a non-interferometric setup for the targeted and non-targeted analysis of various organic solvent vapours. With a time resolution as small as 10 μs and a high dynamic range reaching three orders of magnitude in concentration, this approach is suitable for the real-time analysis of chemical kinetics.

title: CMOS compatible probabilistic computing hardware with cointegrated reconfigurable p-bits and synapse arrays
summary_zh: 本文研究CMOS兼容的概率计算硬件。方法上，集成可重构p-bit和突触阵列。实验表明，该硬件实现了室温下解决组合优化问题的能力。
summary_en: This paper studies CMOS-compatible probabilistic computing hardware. The method involves integrating reconfigurable p-bits and synapse arrays. Experiments show that this hardware enables the ability to solve combinatorial optimization problems at room temperature.
insights: 创新点：实现CMOS兼容的概率计算硬件
方法亮点：集成可重构p-bit和突触阵列
关键发现：室温下解决组合优化问题的能力
insights_en: Novelty: Achieves CMOS-compatible probabilistic computing hardware
Method highlight: Integrates reconfigurable p-bits and synapse arrays
Key finding: Ability to solve combinatorial optimization problems at room temperature
abstract: Probabilistic computing (p-computing) has emerged as a promising approach to solve combinatorial optimization problems (COPs) at room temperature, offering a practical alternative to quantum computing. Scalable p-computing hardware requires integration of probabilistic bits (p-bits) and synapses, two components with inherently contrasting device requirements. Here, we present a charge-trap field-effect transistor (CT-FET) with a silicon-oxide-nitride-silicon gate stack that functions reconfigurably as both a p-bit and a synapse, derived from a commercialized flash memory structure. Gate voltage control of trap energy enables stochastic shallow trap operation for p-bits and stable deep trap operation for synapses. P-bits and synapse array are cointegrated on a single wafer using standard CMOS processes, enabling scalable p-computing hardware. Experimental validation shows successful solution of a 4-node weighted max-cut problem including negative weights, while simulations confirm efficient solution of a 20-node weighted max-cut problem including negative weights via chaotic simulated annealing. These results demonstrate a CMOS compatible pathway toward practical and scalable probabilistic processors.

title: Reconfigurable skin electronics enabled by intrinsically stretchable photoelectric memory transistors
summary_zh: 本文研究通过可拉伸光电存储晶体管实现可重构皮肤电子器件。方法上，结合非挥发性数据存储和光电器件功能。实验表明，这些晶体管在拉伸下保持稳定运行。
summary_en: This paper studies reconfigurable skin electronics enabled by intrinsically stretchable photoelectric memory transistors. The method involves combining non-volatile data storage with optoelectrically reconfigurable logic-in-memory functionality. Experiments show that these transistors maintain stable operation under stretching.
insights: 创新点：通过可拉伸光电存储晶体管实现可重构皮肤电子器件
方法亮点：结合非挥发性数据存储和光电器件功能
关键发现：晶体管在拉伸下保持稳定运行
insights_en: Novelty: Achieves reconfigurable skin electronics through intrinsically stretchable photoelectric memory transistors
Method highlight: Combining non-volatile data storage with optoelectrically reconfigurable logic-in-memory functionality
Key finding: Transistors maintain stable operation under stretching
abstract: Skin electronics requires devices that are both mechanically compliant and computationally versatile, integrating sensing, storage, and logic within soft form factors. Here, we report intrinsically stretchable photoelectric memory transistors that combine non-volatile data storage with optoelectrically reconfigurable logic-in-memory functionality. The devices consist of a nanoconfined polymer semiconductor embedded in an elastomer matrix and a maleic anhydride-functionalized dielectric that also serves as a charge-trapping layer. Programming is achieved with visible light under positive gate bias and erasing with ultraviolet light under negative bias, enabling reversible, multi-level optical programmability. These transistors maintain stable operation under 30% biaxial strain and 1,000 mechanical cycles, with robust retention (10⁷ s) and endurance (10<sup>3</sup> cycles). At the single-transistor level, they define always-open ('1') and always-closed ('0') states that can be reconfigured into diverse logic gates. Finally, we demonstrate wafer-scale integration of various reconfigurable logic-in-memory architectures on a 4-inch elastomeric substrate, establishing a system-level platform that parallels field-programmable gate arrays in a fully stretchable form factor for adaptive and intelligent skin electronics that co-localize data storage and computation.

title: Spin-polarized light-emitting diodes based on CrI₃ operating without external spin injection
summary_zh: 本文研究基于CrI₃的磁极化发光二极管，无需外部自旋注入。方法上，采用单层CrI₃作为发射体，夹在两个石墨烯/六方氮化硼隧道接触之间。实验表明，这些接触注入未极化的自旋。
summary_en: This paper studies spin-polarized light-emitting diodes based on CrI₃ that operate without external spin injection. The method involves using monolayer CrI₃ as the emitter, sandwiched between two graphene/hexagonal boron nitride tunneling contacts. Experiments show that these contacts inject unpolarized spins.
insights: 创新点：无需外部自旋注入的CrI₃磁极化发光二极管
方法亮点：使用单层CrI₃作为发射体，无需复杂外延生长
关键发现：接触注入未极化的自旋
insights_en: Novelty: Spin-polarized light-emitting diodes based on CrI₃ operating without external spin injection
Method highlight: Uses monolayer CrI₃ as the emitter without complex epitaxial growth
Key finding: Contacts inject unpolarized spins
abstract: Spin-polarized light-emitting diodes convert electron spin into circularly polarized light, enabling direct optical readout of spin information and applications in on-chip information processing. Previous demonstrations have largely relied on GaAs-based emitters integrated with spin injectors. These devices, however, require complex epitaxial growth, limiting integration, while high circular polarization remains difficult, demanding high-quality materials for efficient spin injection, coherent spin transport, and spin-conserving radiative recombination. Here, we report an alternative approach for spin-polarized light-emitting diodes by employing monolayer CrI₃ as the emitter, sandwiched between two graphene/hexagonal boron nitride tunneling contacts. Although these contacts inject unpolarized carriers into CrI₃, the resulting electroluminescence exhibits circular polarization, with helicity governed by the magnetic order of CrI₃. Notably, the electroluminescence degree of polarization reaches 20% and its helicity can be reversed with a low magnetic field (~0.17 T). Combined with the inherent integrability of heterostructures, this approach provides a promising platform for future on-chip spin-optoelectronics.

title: Multidimensional control of surface acoustic wave generation via programmable interdigital transducer arrays
summary_zh: 本文研究通过可编程指状换能器阵列实现表面声波的多维控制。方法上，使用双极双投开关实现二进制相反转。实验表明，该系统生成了多种表面声波波形，包括非衍射Airy表面声波和动态聚焦表面声波。
summary_en: This paper studies multidimensional control of surface acoustic wave generation via programmable interdigital transducer arrays. The method involves using double-pole-double-throw switches to enable binary phase inversion. Experiments show that this system generates diverse SAW waveforms, including non-diffracting Airy SAWs and dynamically focused SAWs.
insights: 创新点：通过可编程指状换能器阵列实现表面声波的多维控制
方法亮点：使用双极双投开关实现二进制相反转
关键发现：生成多种表面声波波形
insights_en: Novelty: Achieves multidimensional control of surface acoustic wave generation via programmable interdigital transducer arrays
Method highlight: Uses double-pole-double-throw switches to enable binary phase inversion
Key finding: Generates diverse SAW waveforms
abstract: Fixed interdigital transducers (IDTs) are commonly limited to only generate a single type of surface acoustic wave (SAW). Here, we present a programmable IDT array architecture for multidimensional SAW generation, based on standard and chirped IDT array designs. Forty independently addressable IDT units are each modulated by a double-pole-double-throw switch to enable binary phase inversion. This system generates diverse SAW waveforms including non-diffracting Airy SAWs and dynamically focused SAWs. We achieve two-dimensional focus manipulation with sub-wavelength precision and extended focal depth, enabled by time-division multiplexing with chirped IDTs. By combining spatial phase encoding with spectral frequency multiplexing, our approach demonstrates multidimensional control over SAW generation, providing a platform for adaptive acoustic field control in applications such as reconfigurable microfluidics, tuneable metamaterials, and multifrequency sensing systems.

title: A thousand-state optoelectronic memory for high-precision spatiotemporal encoding
summary_zh: 开发新型光电存储器，实现多级光响应和存储。设计异质结器件，增强载流子传输。解决多状态存储噪声问题。
summary_en: Develops a novel optoelectronic memory with multilevel light response and storage. Designs a heterojunction device to enhance carrier transport. Solves the noise problem in multi-state storage.
insights: 创新点：新型光电存储器
方法亮点：异质结器件设计
关键发现：多状态存储噪声抑制
insights_en: Novelty: Novel optoelectronic memory
Method highlight: Heterojunction device design
Key finding: Noise suppression in multi-state storage
abstract: Conventional photodiodes can distinguish subtle illumination variations, but fail to retain information. Conversely, optoelectronic memories can store light information but encounter difficulties in multiple-state storage due to noise from the deexcitation recombination of the photogenerated carriers. Here we develop an optoelectronic memory that can generate a multilevel response to light stimuli and retain the multi-states in a nonvolatile manner. In the designed type-III heterojunction device, electrons flow from high-Fermi-level (E<sub>f</sub>) p-type amorphous carbon to low-E<sub>f</sub> n-type TiO<sub>x</sub>, generating an unusual built-in electric field that enhances majority carrier transport. Photogenerated electrons from the oxygen vacancies in TiO<sub>x</sub> quickly combine with holes from amorphous carbon, effectively reducing deexcitation recombination with charged vacancies and associated noise. The resulting device achieves 1,024 distinguishable optoelectronic memory states without any denoising process, enabling high-precision spatiotemporal information encoding. The thousands of states in optoelectronic memory allows for the emulation raptor vision to perception fast-moving objects.

title: Bifunctional ligand-bridged electrolyte enables high-capacity and high-energy 600 Wh kg−1 lithium-metal battery pouch cells
summary_zh: 开发多功能配体桥接电解质，提高锂金属电池性能。利用动态桥接剂形成离子聚集体，加速界面动力学。
summary_en: Develops a bifunctional ligand-bridged electrolyte to enhance lithium-metal battery performance. Utilizes dynamic bridging agents to form ionic aggregates, accelerating interfacial kinetics.
insights: 创新点：多功能配体桥接电解质
方法亮点：动态桥接剂应用
关键发现：界面动力学加速
insights_en: Novelty: Bifunctional ligand-bridged electrolyte
Method highlight: Dynamic bridging agent application
Key finding: Accelerated interfacial kinetics
abstract: Lithium metal batteries offer a pathway toward next-generation energy storage due to their high specific energy. However, their implementation remains challenging, particularly under lean electrolyte conditions, where unstable interfaces and inefficient ion transport severely limit cycling stability. Here, we show a bifunctional ligand-bridged electrolyte by integrating ethyl difluoroacetate into a lithium nitrate/triethyl phosphate matrix. Incorporating ethyl difluoroacetate as a dynamic bridging agent drives the formation of interconnected ionic aggregates through synergistic H<sup>δ+</sup> - O<sup>δ-</sup> hydrogen bonding with anions and coordination interactions with Li⁺, thereby accelerating interfacial kinetics and suppressing parasitic reactions. The electrolyte further enables weakly coordinating solvents to engage in the solvation sheath via non-classical hydrogen bonding, facilitating the formation of a robust, inorganic-rich solid electrolyte interphase. This design enables the realization of high-capacity (14 Ah) Li‖Ni95 pouch cells, which achieve a specific energy of 606.8 Wh kg<sup>-1</sup> while maintaining 92.9% capacity retention after 75 cycles at rates of 0.1 C/0.2 C. These findings demonstrate a viable electrolyte strategy for enabling high-performance lithium metal batteries under practical conditions.

title: Room-temperature electrochemical hydroxyalkylation of pyridines
summary_zh: 室温电化学策略实现吡啶的羟基烷基化。方法简单，无需金属，高效。
summary_en: Achieves room-temperature electrochemical hydroxyalkylation of pyridines. Method is simple, metal-free, and efficient.
insights: 创新点：室温电化学策略
方法亮点：无需金属催化
关键发现：高效反应
insights_en: Novelty: Room-temperature electrochemical strategy
Method highlight: Metal-free catalysis
Key finding: Efficient reaction
abstract: Direct and selective functionalization of ubiquitous pyridine scaffold is of paramount importance across numerous fields, yet remains challenging due to the inherent inertness of pyridines and the presence of competing reactive sites. Here, using an undivided cell equipped with a zinc cathode, a graphite anode, and a TEMPO mediator, we report a room-temperature electrochemical strategy that enables the direct hydroxyalkylation of diverse pyridines with readily available carbonyl compounds. This method features a broad substrate scope, operational simplicity, metal-free conditions, and high step/atom economy. It overcomes the limitations of conventional approaches requiring pre-functionalized substrates or stoichiometric activators, establishing a practical platform for direct access to C4- or C2-hydroxyalkyl pyridines, depending on the substitution pattern of the pyridine substrates. Mechanistic studies reveal that acetic acid activates both reactants, and the products are formed via cross-coupling of cathodic reduction-induced pyridyl radicals and hydroxy α-radicals followed by protonation and anodic oxidative aromatization.

title: Thermal-stress enhanced pyroelectricity in piezoelectric bimorphs
summary_zh: 通过热应力增强压电双晶的焦电性。利用聚合物和陶瓷的热膨胀不匹配。
summary_en: Enhances pyroelectricity in piezoelectric bimorphs through thermal stress. Utilizes the thermal expansion mismatch between polymer and ceramic.
insights: 创新点：热应力增强焦电性
方法亮点：热膨胀不匹配利用
关键发现：聚合物/陶瓷结合
insights_en: Novelty: Thermal stress enhances pyroelectricity
Method highlight: Utilizing thermal expansion mismatch
Key finding: Polymer/ceramic combination
abstract: Enhancing pyroelectric performance is essential for advancing thermal sensing and energy-harvesting applications. This study presents an effective strategy to achieve highly enhanced pyroelectricity in a flexible polyvinylidene fluoride/mica bimorph. Unlike conventional approaches that focus on domain-phase engineering to enhance intrinsic pyroelectric contribution, we engineer a more dominant role for the secondary pyroelectric contribution by a stress-induced shape change that couples to a change in the polarization via the piezoelectric effect. This mechanism is enabled by the favorable combination of a large thermal-expansion mismatch between the polymer (polyvinylidene fluoride) and the ceramic (mica), together with the inherent mechanical compliance of mica's flexibility, which allows interfacial thermal stresses to efficiently generate piezoelectricity. By combining experimental characterization with finite element modeling of the heterostructure's temperature-dependent curvature, interfacial thermal stress is identified as the dominant contributor to the large effects. Direct pyroelectric measurements reveal a highly enhanced pyroelectric coefficient ≈ -359 µC/m<sup>2</sup>K, more than an order of magnitude greater than that of single-layer polyvinylidene fluoride, highlighting its potential for applications in flexible electronics, thermal sensors, and energy harvesting systems.

title: Oxidation-reconstructed Li+ transport enables high-tap-density single-crystal regeneration of spent LiNi0.5Co0.2Mn0.3O2 positive electrodes
summary_zh: 氧化重构策略实现废旧正极材料的高密度单晶再生。表面NiO转化为NiOOH，改善Li+传输。
summary_en: Oxidation reconstruction strategy enables high-density single-crystal regeneration of spent LiNi0.5Co0.2Mn0.3O2 positive electrodes. Surface NiO transforms into NiOOH, improving Li+ transport.
insights: 创新点：氧化重构策略
方法亮点：表面NiO转化
关键发现：Li+传输改善
insights_en: Novelty: Oxidation reconstruction strategy
Method highlight: Surface NiO transformation
Key finding: Improved Li+ transport
abstract: Direct regeneration offers a shortcut to close the material supply loop of lithium-ion batteries and is a promising recycling strategy. However, in spent LiNi<sub>0.5</sub>Co<sub>0.2</sub>Mn<sub>0.3</sub>O<sub>2</sub> positive electrode, severe bulk cation disorder and surface rock salt phase hinder Li<sup>+</sup> reinsertion. Moreover, the coexistence of single and poly-crystal particles in commercial batteries further complicates uniform re-lithiation and morphological regeneration. Herein, we propose an oxidation strategy to simultaneously regulate the structural reconstruction and morphological evolution of spent material. During oxidation, surface NiO transforms into NiOOH, while targeted oxidation of the anti-site Ni<sup>2+</sup> to Ni<sup>3+</sup> in the bulk reduces Li<sup>+</sup>/Ni<sup>2+</sup> mixing. This reconstructs Li<sup>+</sup> diffusion channels from surface to bulk, facilitating re-lithiation. Meanwhile, structural changes induce lattice expansion in secondary particles, causing their decomposition into primary particles and forming uniform precursor particles. These particles, with continuous Li<sup>+</sup> transport channels and NiOOH surface, agglomerate into large single-crystal during calcination. The regenerated LiNi<sub>0.5</sub>Co<sub>0.2</sub>Mn<sub>0.3</sub>O<sub>2</sub> achieves a high tap density of 2.57 g/cm<sup>3</sup> and retains 80.2% capacity after 600 cycles. This work presents a concept for the direct regeneration of degradable positive materials.

title: Molecular cobalt catalysts for electrocatalytic acetylene semi-hydrogenation
summary_zh: 研究电催化乙炔半加氢的钴催化剂。CoPc催化剂抑制副产物，优化活性氢吸附。
summary_en: Studies cobalt catalysts for electrocatalytic acetylene semi-hydrogenation. CoPc catalysts suppress by-products and optimize active hydrogen adsorption.
insights: 创新点：钴催化剂研究
方法亮点：CoPc催化剂应用
关键发现：副产物抑制
insights_en: Novelty: Cobalt catalyst study
Method highlight: CoPc catalyst application
Key finding: By-product suppression
abstract: Electrocatalytic acetylene semi-hydrogenation is an attractive route for ethylene production, but competing side reactions like hydrogen evolution, over-hydrogenation, and C-C coupling severely compromise its industrial viability. Here, we present a carbon-nanotube-supported metal phthalocyanine platform, MPc/XCNT (M = Cu, Co, Ni, Fe; X = O, N, S), to investigate the roles of metal centers and local coordination environments. Among these catalysts, CoPc-based structures exhibit markedly enhanced water dissociation kinetics and elevated C-C coupling energy barriers compared to conventional CuPc-based catalysts, thereby effectively suppressing undesired C<sub>4</sub> by-products. Furthermore, molecular regulation of the Co center optimizes active hydrogen adsorption and utilization, mitigating both hydrogen evolution and over-hydrogenation. As a result, the optimized CoPc/NCNT catalyst delivers competitive performance under both high current densities and ethylene-rich conditions. At an industrially relevant -500 mA cm<sup>-2</sup> under a pure ethylene feed, it achieves 86.7% Faradaic efficiency with a turnover frequency of 7019 min<sup>-1</sup>. Under simulated industrial crude conditions, it maintains 99.7% conversion and 99.5% selectivity during 110-hour continuous operation. This work provides a well-defined molecular strategy for advancing selective electrocatalytic transformations.

title: Author Correction: Coordination-tailored atomic interfaces for selective CH4-to-C2 conversion in aqueous solution
summary_zh: 作者纠正：关于水溶液中CH4到C2选择性转化的配位定制原子界面。
summary_en: Author correction: On coordination-tailored atomic interfaces for selective CH4-to-C2 conversion in aqueous solution.
insights: 创新点：配位定制原子界面
方法亮点：水溶液转化研究
关键发现：CH4到C2转化
insights_en: Novelty: Coordination-tailored atomic interfaces
Method highlight: Aqueous solution conversion study
Key finding: CH4-to-C2 conversion
abstract: In the version of this article initially published, an O 2 -TPD panel in Supplementary Fig. 32 was inadvertently mislabeled as CH 4 -TPD due to an error during figure preparation.This correction does not affect the article's conclusions regarding the catalyst's CH 4 adsorption behavior.Edits have been made to the corresponding description in "The origin of the catalytic performance" section of the main text where the current text "The contact angle measurements (CA, Fig. 5g) of CH 4 bubbles on water and O 2 temperature-programmed desorption (TPD, Supplementary Fig. S32) profiles were conducted.Compared with C 3 N 4 (CA = 105), Fe-DAC/g-C 3 N 4 exhibits a significantly reduced CH4 CA of 60" has replaced the original "The contact angle measurements (CA, Fig. 5g) of CH 4 bubbles on water and CH 4 /O 2 temperature-programmed desorption (TPD, Supplementary Fig. S32) profiles were conducted.Compared with C3N4 (CA = 105; T = 30.4C), Fe-DAC/g-C 3 N 4 exhibits a significantly reduced CH 4 CA of 60and a considerably higher CH 4 desorption temperature of 56.0 C."The changes have been made

title: Fuel availability versus flammability: divergent fire controls across Eurasian drylands
summary_zh: 研究欧亚干旱地区的燃料可用性和可燃性对火灾控制的影响。
summary_en: Studies the impact of fuel availability and flammability on fire control across Eurasian drylands.
insights: 创新点：火灾控制研究
方法亮点：燃料可用性分析
关键发现：火灾模式识别
insights_en: Novelty: Fire control study
Method highlight: Fuel availability analysis
Key finding: Fire pattern recognition
abstract: Fire regulates the carbon, water and nutrient cycles, especially in regions with distinct wet and dry seasons. The dramatic vegetation response to climatic factors complicates fire preconditions in Eurasian drylands, leaving our understanding of climate-fuel-fire patterns limited. Here we identify eight pyromes with unique combinations of fire characteristics of size, expansion, frequency and duration. We find these pyromes are geographically contiguous and exhibit varied response to climate, fuel load, fuel flammability and human activities. Fuel load is closely related to fast-spreading fires in Eurasian Steppe, which mostly belongs to the large-fast-frequent-long (LFFL) and medium-fast-intermediate-short (MFIS) pyromes. There, antecedent fine fuel accumulation during the growing season dries out in the subsequent dry season, is ignited by human activity and spreads rapidly. High-latitude regions are dominated by slow-spreading but long-lasting fires (large-slow-rare-long (LSRL) and medium-slow-intermediate-long (MSIL) pyromes), where changes in fuel flammability due to long-term climate stress determine fire extent. These findings provide initial guidance of which controls should be considered for improving predictions of fire activity and fire risk assessment across Eurasian drylands.

title: Europe’s land take and the loss of nature and cropland to artificial surfaces
summary_zh: 研究欧洲土地占用情况，发现自然和农业用地损失严重。土地占用主要发生在城市和农业区域，草地受影响最大。
summary_en: This study investigates Europe's land take, revealing significant loss of natural and agricultural land. Land take is predominantly in urban and agricultural areas, with grasslands most affected.
insights: 创新点：发现土地占用对自然和农业用地的影响远超预期。
方法亮点：利用高分辨率卫星数据进行分析。
关键发现：草地受土地占用影响最大。
insights_en: Novelty: The impact of land take on natural and agricultural land is found to be far greater than expected.
Method highlight: Analysis using high-resolution satellite data.
Key finding: Grasslands are most affected by land take.
abstract: The expansion of artificial surfaces, also known as land take, is a major contributor to habitat loss and biodiversity decline. Using high-resolution satellite data, we find that between 2018 and 2023 Europe lost 912 ± 74 km<sup>2</sup> yr<sup>-1</sup> of natural and semi-natural land cover and 588 ± 27 km<sup>2</sup> yr<sup>-1</sup> of cropland due to land take - nearly twice as large as previous estimates. Countries exhibiting the greatest land take per capita are Norway and Estonia, while Switzerland and Spain are most land efficient. The majority of land take (80%) occurs within modified ecosystems such as urban greenspace and semi-natural agricultural areas. Grasslands are disproportionately affected, with land take rates nearly five times that of other (semi-)natural ecosystems. The main land-use drivers of land take are residential (41%) and transport/logistics development (22%), and are therefore priority industries for targeting mitigation policies. Our methods provide a template for design-based monitoring of land take and call for an economic valuation of the ecosystem services lost due to land take.

title: Origin of multiple skyrmion phases in EuAl4
summary_zh: 研究EuAl4中多种skyrmion相的起源，发现电荷密度波破坏了局部对称性，允许DM相互作用。
summary_en: This study explores the origin of multiple skyrmion phases in EuAl4, revealing that charge-density wave breaks local symmetry, allowing for DM interaction.
insights: 创新点：揭示了电荷密度波在skyrmion形成中的作用。
方法亮点：使用软X射线角分辨光电子能谱。
关键发现：DM相互作用并非skyrmion形成的唯一机制。
insights_en: Novelty: The role of charge-density wave in skyrmion formation is revealed.
Method highlight: Soft-x-ray angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy used.
Key finding: DM interaction is not the only mechanism for skyrmion formation.
abstract: The Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya (DM) interaction has been considered essential for skyrmion formation, however, the discovery of skyrmion lattices (SkLs) in nominally centrosymmetric materials where the DM interaction is forbidden, such as Eu(Ga<sub>1-x</sub>Al<sub>x</sub>)<sub>4</sub>, has challenged this established view. Recent structural investigations of Eu(Ga<sub>1-x</sub>Al<sub>x</sub>)<sub>4</sub> have further complicated this issue by revealing that the charge-density wave breaks local symmetry, theoretically allowing DM interaction. This raises a fundamental question: are the complex magnetic phases driven by the DM interaction or by alternative mechanisms? Here, using soft-x-ray angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy, we determine the three-dimensional bulk electronic structure of Eu(Ga<sub>1-x</sub>Al<sub>x</sub>)<sub>4</sub>, and elucidate the electronic origins of its rich magnetic orders. We directly observe an x-dependent Lifshitz transition leading to the emergence of a Fermi-surface pocket. Importantly, multiple nesting vectors derived from this pocket match the symmetries and periodicities of the multiple SkLs. Moreover, these nesting vectors can also account for other magnetic orders, such as the zero-field helical magnetism, suggesting a common electronic origin of the complex magnetic phases. These findings suggest that competing nesting-induced Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yosida interactions and their engineering can generate and control various SkLs and related topological spin textures.

title: Observation of D’yakonov-Perel’-type magnon spin relaxation in uniaxial antiferromagnetic insulators
summary_zh: 研究单轴反铁磁绝缘体中的D'yakonov-Perel'-type自旋弛豫机制，发现其在Cr2O3和α-Fe2O3中起主导作用。
summary_en: This study observes the D'yakonov-Perel'-type magnon spin relaxation mechanism in uniaxial antiferromagnetic insulators, finding it to be dominant in Cr2O3 and α-Fe2O3.
insights: 创新点：在反铁磁绝缘体中观察到D'yakonov-Perel'-type自旋弛豫。
方法亮点：结合实验和理论模型。
关键发现：自旋电流传输受D'yakonov-Perel'-type自旋弛豫机制控制。
insights_en: Novelty: D'yakonov-Perel'-type magnon spin relaxation is observed in antiferromagnetic insulators.
Method highlight: Combining experiment and theoretical model.
Key finding: Spin current transport is governed by the D'yakonov-Perel'-type magnon spin relaxation mechanism.
abstract: Long-distance transport of magnon spin currents in antiferromagnetic (AFM) insulators has attracted tremendous attention recently, however, the AFM magnon spin relaxation mechanisms remain elusive. Here, we report that the D'yakonov-Perel'-type magnon spin relaxation mechanism governs the spin current transport along the easy axis in two prototypical uniaxial AFM insulators, Cr<sub>2</sub>O<sub>3</sub> and <mml:math xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mml:mi>α</mml:mi></mml:math>-Fe<sub>2</sub>O<sub>3</sub>. First, an over 450% enhancement of the first-harmonic nonlocal signal induced by a magnetic field is observed prior to the spin-flop transition, which can be well-interpreted by our model incorporating D'yakonov-Perel'-type magnon spin relaxation. Secondly, we find that the magnon spin diffusion length in both crystals increases with magnetic field and saturates at fields above 0.8 T, consistent with our model. Finally, the temperature dependence of the zero-field magnon spin diffusion length in both AFM insulators can be qualitatively explained through our model. These findings are valuable for the development of low-dissipation antiferromagnetic spintronic devices.

title: Generalizable growth of 2D twisted transition metal dichalcogenide heterostructures under non-equilibrium thermodynamic conditions
summary_zh: 研究非平衡热力学条件下二维扭曲过渡金属硫族化合物异质结构的可扩展生长，发现加热速率控制对扭曲角度有显著影响。
summary_en: This study investigates the generalizable growth of 2D twisted transition metal dichalcogenide heterostructures under non-equilibrium thermodynamic conditions, finding that heating rate significantly affects the twist angle.
insights: 创新点：提出了一种加热速率控制化学气相沉积方法。
方法亮点：通过加热过程实现外延生长。
关键发现：加热速率影响二维扭曲TMD异质结构的扭曲角度。
insights_en: Novelty: A heating rate-controlled chemical vapor deposition method is proposed.
Method highlight: Epitaxial growth during the heating process.
Key finding: Heating rate affects the twist angle of 2D twisted TMD heterostructures.
abstract: Twisted two-dimensional (2D) transition metal dichalcogenide (TMD) structures have emerged as a versatile platform for optoelectronics and quantum materials, but their controlled bottom-up synthesis remains challenging. Here, we report a heating rate-controlled chemical vapor deposition method to grow various TMD heterostructures with improved control over the twist angle by enabling epitaxial growth during the heating process, rather than conventional isothermal stages. Specifically, a low heating rate (10 °C/min) is found to favor twist angles ≤ 22.5°, whereas a high rate (≥ 30 °C/min) promotes twist angles ≥ 30.0°. Theoretical analysis suggests that this strategy enhances high-energy molecular collisions and reduces kinetic energy barriers for the formation of 2D twisted TMD van der Waals (vdW) heterostructures. This method enables the synthesis of 18 different twisted TMD heterostructures. Systematic characterizations confirm twist-angle-dependent moiré periodicity and interlayer coupling correlation in these structures. Transient reflection (TR) in WSe<sub>2</sub>/WS<sub>2</sub> bilayers reveal a non-monotonic carrier lifetime modulation, prolonged at intermediate angles. Our study provides a generalizable pathway for fabricating twisted vdW heterostructures.

title: Tracking polar solvation dynamics of a photoexcited organic chromophore with ultrafast X-ray scattering
summary_zh: 使用超快X射线散射追踪光激发有机染料分子的极性溶剂化动力学，揭示溶剂壳重组和再平衡过程。
summary_en: This study tracks the polar solvation dynamics of a photoexcited organic chromophore with ultrafast X-ray scattering, revealing the reorganization and reequilibration of the solvation shell.
insights: 创新点：直接观察了光激发分子周围的溶剂重组。
方法亮点：使用X射线自由电子激光器进行时间分辨实验。
关键发现：溶剂壳重组由光诱导电荷转移驱动。
insights_en: Novelty: Direct observation of solvent reorganization around photoexcited molecules.
Method highlight: Time-resolved experiments using an X-ray free-electron laser.
Key finding: Solvation shell reorganization is driven by photoinduced charge transfer.
abstract: Solvation plays a key role in many photochemical and biological processes. Yet, direct atomic-scale observation of solvent reorganization around photoexcited molecules containing only light atoms has so far remained elusive. Here, we use time-resolved X-ray scattering at an X-ray free-electron laser to track with a ~ 120 fs time resolution the photoinduced ultrafast rearrangement of polar acetonitrile solvent molecules around an organic hemithioindigo chromophore. The experiments reveal that the solvation shell reorganizes with a ~ 0.3 ps time constant driven by photoinduced charge transfer in the chromophore, and then reequilibrates over ~ 3 ps as the excited state population returns to the ground state. These results demonstrate the viability of using ultrashort X-ray pulses to directly visualize the motion of light atoms in solution, paving the way for atomic-scale understanding and control of photoinduced processes in biological and synthetic photoactive organic molecules.

title: Geospatial green ammonia co-firing in China’s coal power fleets to avoid CO2 emissions lock-in
summary_zh: 研究中国煤炭发电厂中绿色氨共燃烧以避免CO2排放锁定，发现地理空间优化分配策略有效。
summary_en: This study investigates geospatial green ammonia co-firing in China's coal power fleets to avoid CO2 emissions lock-in, finding that geospatially optimized allocation strategies are effective.
insights: 创新点：提出了一种地理空间优化分配策略。
方法亮点：考虑了氨生产中心和燃煤电厂之间的空间匹配。
关键发现：地理空间优化分配策略可显著降低CO2排放。
insights_en: Novelty: A geospatially optimized allocation strategy is proposed.
Method highlight: Considered spatial mismatch between ammonia production hubs and coal power plants.
Key finding: Geospatially optimized allocation can significantly reduce CO2 emissions.
abstract: China's 600 gigawatts (GW) of post-2010 coal power capacity locks in over 2 gigatons (Gt) of annual CO₂ emissions. Green ammonia co-firing offers a viable decarbonization pathway, yet spatial mismatch between ammonia production hubs and coal power plants remains a barrier. Here, we develop a spatially explicit framework covering 3958 islanded green ammonia production hubs to evaluate coal power units' spatial retrofit outcomes under two distinct co-firing strategies: local sourcing and geospatially optimized allocation. Results show that despite green ammonia subsidies, high fuel utilization costs persist for the local sourcing strategy, thereby limiting cumulative energy-related CO₂ reductions to 1.9-4.2 Gt (2020-2060) depending on climate policy stringency. In contrast, a geospatially optimized allocation strategy leveraging key transport corridors (e.g., Inner Mongolia to Hebei, Shandong, and Shanxi) delivers cumulative CO₂ abatement of 7.8-15.2 Gt, cuts cumulative CO₂ capture demand by 1.6-6.8 Gt, and lowers cumulative system costs between 2020 and 2060, relative to the local sourcing strategy.

title: Fe-based metallic glasses as efficient oxygen scavengers
summary_zh: 研究铁基金属玻璃作为高效氧清除剂，发现其去除氧气的速率和容量远超传统系统。
summary_en: This study investigates Fe-based metallic glasses as efficient oxygen scavengers, finding they achieve much higher oxygen removal rates and capacities than conventional systems.
insights: 创新点：发现铁基金属玻璃具有高效的氧清除能力。
方法亮点：密度泛函理论计算揭示了氧清除机制。
关键发现：铁基金属玻璃的氧去除速率和容量超过理论极限。
insights_en: Novelty: Fe-based metallic glasses are found to have efficient oxygen scavenging capabilities.
Method highlight: Density functional theory calculations reveal the oxygen scavenging mechanism.
Key finding: The oxygen removal rates and capacities of Fe-based metallic glasses exceed theoretical limits.
abstract: Ubiquitous oxygen drives degradation, spoilage, and side reactions, making oxygen scavenging essential for materials preservation and reaction stabilization. However, conventional oxygen scavengers exhibit limited oxygen removal rates and capacities far below their theoretical maximums, wasting resources while lagging behind industry needs. Here, we report Fe-based metallic glasses as efficient oxygen scavengers, achieving oxygen removal rates 1-4 orders of magnitude higher than conventional systems. In FeSiB metallic glass, Fe oxidation synergistically activates Si, delivering a 24-hour oxygen removal capacity of 1.439 L g<sup>-1</sup>-reaching the Fe-based theoretical limit-and a 48-hour capacity of 1.596 L g<sup>-1</sup>, surpassing it. Density functional theory calculations reveal that the amorphous structure significantly lowers the oxygen adsorption energy barrier and facilitates O-O bond cleavage. Moreover, the generated self-reinforcing microdomains mediate O<sub>2</sub>/H<sub>2</sub>O transport via robust autocatalytic cycling. These results highlight a promising strategy for oxygen potential control and suggest a possible paradigm for catalytic applications.

title: Shapeshifting exsolved FeNi bimetallic nanostructures as catalytic switchers during the CO2-mediated ethane conversion
summary_zh: 研究FeNi双金属纳米结构在CO2介导的乙烷转化中的可变形催化切换作用，发现其表现出可逆的催化选择性。
summary_en: This study investigates the shapeshifting exsolved FeNi bimetallic nanostructures as catalytic switchers during CO2-mediated ethane conversion, finding they exhibit reversible catalytic selectivity.
insights: 创新点：开发了一种可变形的FeNi双金属纳米结构。
方法亮点：通过控制还原温度实现选择性形成。
关键发现：催化剂表现出乙烷干重整和CO2辅助氧化脱氢的可逆催化选择性。
insights_en: Novelty: A shapeshifting FeNi bimetallic nanostructure is developed.
Method highlight: Selective formation achieved by controlling the reduction temperature.
Key finding: The catalyst exhibits reversible catalytic selectivity between ethane dry reforming and CO2-assisted oxidative dehydrogenation.
abstract: In the era of the energy transition, the development of sustainable, high-performance, and multifunctional catalysts that adapt to complex catalytic processes is essential. Here, we report shapeshifting bimetallic iron-nickel catalysts developed via an exsolution strategy for carbon dioxide-mediated ethane conversion. By controlling the reduction temperature of a perovskite host, either alloyed iron-nickel nanoparticles or oxide-alloy core-shell nanoparticles are selectively formed. Oxidative regeneration of the perovskite enables reversible interconversion between these distinct nanostructures within the same parent material. As a result, the catalyst exhibits switchable selectivity between ethane dry reforming and carbon dioxide-assisted oxidative dehydrogenation while maintaining high stability. Repeated redox cycling confirms that the structural transformation and catalytic performance are largely reversible. These results demonstrate that exsolution provides a robust platform for designing regenerable catalysts with deliberately tunable and switchable catalytic states.

title: Electric current-driven heterogeneous microstructures in dual-phase titanium alloys
summary_zh: 本文研究利用脉冲电流处理制备双相钛合金异质微结构。方法上，通过单步处理实现多尺度相结构。实验表明，该结构显著提升强度和延展性。
summary_en: This paper investigates the preparation of heterogeneous microstructures in dual-phase titanium alloys via pulsed electric current treatment. The method involves a single-step process to achieve a multi-scale phase structure. Experiments show that this structure significantly enhances strength and ductility.
insights: 创新点：脉冲电流处理实现异质微结构制备
方法亮点：单步处理实现多尺度相结构
关键发现：显著提升材料强度和延展性
insights_en: Novelty: Pulsed electric current treatment for heterogeneous microstructure fabrication
Method highlight: Single-step process for multi-scale phase structure achievement
Key finding: Significant enhancement of material strength and ductility
abstract: Heterostructures are a powerful strategy for overcoming the long-standing strength-ductility trade-off in structural materials. However, conventional routes to such architectures often rely on complex thermomechanical treatments, limiting scalability and energy efficiency. Here, we report a hierarchical multiphase heterogeneous microstructure in dual-phase titanium alloys, achieved through a single-step high-density pulsed electric current treatment. The resulting architecture comprises 5-6 phases or components across multi-scale from 1 nm to 10 µm, and exhibits a breakthrough in the strength-ductility trade-off, achieving 13.5% and 12.1% higher strength and 13.1% and 14.5% greater ductility for Ti-6Al-4V and Ti-6Al-7Nb, respectively. In-situ transmission electron microscopy and pre-micromachined structure analysis reveal a previously unreported phase transition mechanism: electron wind-driven precipitation of nanoscale α' martensite within β phases via limited atomic diffusion, accompanied by localized chemical ordering. This work introduces a rapid and energy-efficient processing method, where the entire treatment is completed within milliseconds and the total energy consumption is reduced by more than 50% compared to conventional processing methods. The proposed approach offers a promising route for designing and modifying metallic heterostructures, holding significant implications for next-generation structural materials.

title: Cr and Nd co-doped cobalt oxide for stable proton exchange membrane water electrolysis
_topics: cr and nd co-doped cobalt oxide
summary_zh: 本文设计了一种Cr和Nd共掺杂的钴氧化物电催化剂，用于稳定质子交换膜水电解。方法上，采用原位酸循环策略解决膜中毒问题。实验表明，该催化剂在酸性氧析出反应中表现出高活性和耐久性。
summary_en: This paper designs a Cr and Nd co-doped cobalt oxide electrocatalyst for stable proton exchange membrane water electrolysis. The method involves an in-situ acid circulation strategy to address membrane poisoning issues. Experiments show that the catalyst exhibits high activity and durability in the acidic oxygen evolution reaction.
insights: 创新点：Cr和Nd共掺杂钴氧化物电催化剂设计
方法亮点：原位酸循环策略解决膜中毒
关键发现：高活性和耐久性
insights_en: Novelty: Design of Cr and Nd co-doped cobalt oxide electrocatalyst
Method highlight: In-situ acid circulation strategy for membrane poisoning mitigation
Key finding: High activity and durability
abstract: Developing noble-metal-free electrocatalyst for oxygen evolution reaction in a proton exchange membrane water electrolyzer is a key to sustainable and economical hydrogen production. Herein, we rationally design and develop a chromium and neodymium co-doped cobalt oxide (CrNd-Co<sub>3</sub>O<sub>4</sub>) electrocatalyst that exhibits high activity and durability in the acidic oxygen evolution reaction condition. Furthermore, an in-situ acid circulation strategy is proposed to tackle the ubiquitous issue of membrane poisoning by leached cations in proton exchange membrane water electrolyzers. Consequently, the proton exchange membrane water electrolyzer with CrNd-Co<sub>3</sub>O<sub>4</sub> anode achieves a stable operating current density of 2 amperes per square centimeter at 2.27 volts and 4 amperes per square centimeter at 2.54 volts for 1,000 hours.

title: Dimensional control of low-dimensional perovskite hybrids for photovoltaics
summary_zh: 本文报道了一种通过分子设计策略精确调控钙钛矿结构的分子设计方法。方法上，通过调整末端基团和咪唑间距实现不同维度结构。实验表明，该方法可优化晶体生长动力学和电荷传输特性。
summary_en: This paper reports a molecular design strategy for precise dimensional tuning of perovskite architectures. The method involves adjusting terminal groups and inter-imidazole spacing to achieve different dimensional configurations. Experiments show that this method optimizes crystallization kinetics and charge transport properties.
insights: 创新点：分子设计策略调控钙钛矿结构
方法亮点：调整末端基团和咪唑间距实现维度调控
关键发现：优化晶体生长动力学和电荷传输特性
insights_en: Novelty: Molecular design strategy for perovskite structure tuning
Method highlight: Dimensional tuning via terminal group and inter-imidazole spacing adjustment
Key finding: Optimization of crystallization kinetics and charge transport properties
abstract: Low-dimensional perovskite engineering offers a promising route to improve both power conversion efficiency and stability in perovskite photovoltaics, yet the mechanistic relationship between organic ligand design and structural control remains elusive. Here, we report a molecular design strategy for bis-imidazolium ligands that enables precise dimensional tuning of perovskite architectures, from zero-dimensional through parallel one-dimensional to bridged zero-dimensional configurations. Through systematic variation of terminal groups and inter-imidazole spacing, we achieve controlled growth of high-quality hybrid dimensional perovskite films with optimized crystallization kinetics and charge transport properties. This enables photovoltaic devices with a certified power conversion efficiency of 27.02% (laboratory 27.21%). Scaling this dimensional strategy enables the fabrication of 30×30 cm<sup>2</sup> perovskite solar modules, achieving a champion power conversion efficiency of 21.41% Moreover, unencapsulated devices retain 94.3% of their initial power conversion efficiency after 2000 hours of continuous operation at 60 °C (ISOS-L-2I), highlighting exceptional operational stability.

title: Tuning selectivity in the direct hydrogenolysis of PET plastic over Co catalysts through interfacial hydrogen spillover
summary_zh: 本文实现了PET塑料在Co催化剂上的直接加氢裂解，通过界面氢溢流调节选择性。方法上，通过Co-MOF-71的裂解制备碳载Co纳米颗粒。实验表明，该方法可高效生产对二甲苯和1,4-二甲基环己烷。
summary_en: This paper achieves the direct hydrogenolysis of PET plastic over Co catalysts with interfacial hydrogen spillover for selectivity tuning. The method involves the preparation of carbon-supported Co nanoparticles by pyrolysis of Co-MOF-71. Experiments show that this method can efficiently produce p-xylene and 1,4-dimethylcyclohexane.
insights: 创新点：界面氢溢流调节PET塑料加氢裂解选择性
方法亮点：Co-MOF-71裂解制备碳载Co纳米颗粒
关键发现：高效生产对二甲苯和1,4-二甲基环己烷
insights_en: Novelty: Interfacial hydrogen spillover for selectivity tuning in PET plastic hydrogenolysis
Method highlight: Preparation of carbon-supported Co nanoparticles from Co-MOF-71
Key finding: Efficient production of p-xylene and 1,4-dimethylcyclohexane
abstract: Polyethylene terephthalate (PET) plastic upcycling typically features two-step processes involving cascade depolymerization and functionalization to mixed products. Here, we realize the direct hydrogenolysis of PET over a Co@CoO heterogeneous catalyst, with high yield of either p-xylene (PX, >97 %) or 1,4-dimethylcyclohexane (1,4-DMC, >90 %). Pyrolysis of Co-MOF-71 yields carbon-supported Co nanoparticles partially encapsulated by CoO, whose metal/oxide interface facilitates hydrogen spillover. Experimental and computational investigations reveal Co<sup>δ+</sup> atoms proximate to CoO particles selectively catalyze carboxylate C-O bond cleavage at 250 °C and 1 MPa H<sub>2</sub> to yield PX. In contrast, hydrogen spillover from Co metal to CoO sites at 280 °C and 3 MPa H<sub>2</sub> promotes selective ring hydrogenation to 1,4-DMC. Co/CoO-800 has excellent stability and efficacy for depolymerizing commercial PET plastics. Life cycle assessment indicates the PET-to-PX process offers negative CO<sub>2</sub> emissions and outperforms fossil-fuel PX production. Direct hydrogenolysis over Earth-abundant catalysts offers a simple strategy for polyester waste upcycling.

title: Metal-metal interactions in catalysis from spatial separation to physical mixtures
summary_zh: 本文阐述了从单合金位点到分离结构的转变，最终到双动态模式的催化机制。方法上，通过空间分离金属的物理混合实现催化循环。实验表明，这种动态协同作用为非合金设计提供了蓝图。
summary_en: This paper delineates the fundamental shift from single static alloy sites to dual static separated structures, and ultimately to a dual dynamic mode of catalytic mechanism. The method involves achieving the catalytic cycle through physical mixing of spatially separated metals. Experiments show that this dynamic synergy provides a blueprint for non-alloyed designs.
insights: 创新点：从单合金位点到分离结构的转变
方法亮点：物理混合实现催化循环
关键发现：动态协同作用为非合金设计提供蓝图
